dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "Just please, unless you're an experienced surfer, steer clear of our Sharky Surfboards!"

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "When it comes to speed, Sharky Surfboards blow regular ones out of the water, but they're much harder to control..."

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "If you're not careful, you might end up crashing head-first into a reef!"

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "And if you're unlucky enough to pick up an injury, you'll waste precious vacation time laid up in bed recovering — definitely not a risk worth taking!"
